newsitem.title: USA: Bay View to acquire EXXE, sees EPS boost.
newsitem.headline: Bay View to acquire EXXE, sees EPS boost.

text.p: Bay View Capital Corp said Thursday it has executed a definitive agreement to acquire EXXE Data Corp and its unit Concord Growth Corp, adding that the deal will be accretive to earnings.

Under the terms of the deal shareholders of EXXE capital stock, warrants and options will receive $19.8 million at closing and will be entitled to potential future payments, dependent on the future financial performance of Concord Growth, of up to $34 million.

Bay View said in a statement that the first full year earnings per share enhancement from this deal will be about $0.14 a share or $0.05 more than the estimated $0.09 a share benefit which would be achieved from utilizing the $19.8 million to repurchase shares of Bay View common stock.

The payment of $19.8 million is about 9.4 times the estimated initial year net income for Concord Growth. Cash basis EPS enhancement from this transaction, which excludes the amortization of goodwill arising from the deal, is estimated at $0.30 for the first full year of operations.

The company also said its directors have approved a $25 million share repurchase. After this repurchase Bay View will have bought back about 1.3 million shares, or 17.5 percent of the 7.4 million shares outstanding when the initial share repurchase program was announced.
Concord is a provider of asset-backed financing to small businesses.
